text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> Pager: RateLimiterService high error rate (500/429) for /v1/generate. Severity: P1. page_id: PD-78912

maria: Acked. Looking now. Any visible deploys in last 30m?

kevin: I saw a spike at ~1759123300 in limiter logs, looks like token bucket refills stalled on s1. Pulling logs.

david: I can confirm increased 429s from RL-Limiter returning 'quota-misapplied' to some tenants after the autoscaler scaled controllers down. Could be race in policy refresh.

sasha: Paging support to gather customer impact. @support-bot can you compile a list of affected customers (by id) for the last 15m?

support-bot: Found 8 distinct customers with >50 429s in last 15m. Top 3: cust-42 (ecom), cust-88 (ad-tech), cust-101 (analytics). Opened support ticket #INC-2738 and notified CS.

kevin: Attempting soft restart of limiter service on s1 (kubectl scale deployment/rate-limiter -n prod --replicas=0 then back to 3). Will run one shard at a time to avoid full outage.

maria: Good. Also start a rollback of the last config push if restart doesn't stabilize. Which commit was that?

kevin: Last config push: infra/limiter: d4f2b7a (10:40 UTC). I'm tailing logs:
```
2026-03-11T10:44:01Z limiter svc s1 ERROR token_refill_loop: refill failed: write timeout
2026-03-11T10:44:02Z limiter svc s1 WARN policy_fetch: fetch returned 404 for tenant cust-88
2026-03-11T10:44:05Z limiter svc s1 INFO reconnecting to kv-store
```

sasha: That 404 pattern + kv-store reconnection suggests config sync issue after autoscaler churn. Could be transient but need to confirm KV latency.

david: I'm rolling a quick canary revert to the previous config (d4f2b7a -> c9a1e33). Deploying to s1-a now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert escalated to on-call SRE after 120s (kevin acked). Escalation path: oncall -> senior-sre.

kevin: s1-a restart done, logs show policy_fetch success now. 429s for cust-88 dropping.

maria: Observing client 429 rate graph: overall 429 spike peaked at 10:45 and is down ~85% after restart. Still seeing some 500s from token refill errors.

kevin: Kicking KV connection health check and increasing timeouts on the client as a hotfix. Applied patch to limiter sidecar config (timeout=10s -> 20s).

sasha: Noted. Support: please notify top customers that we're investigating and mitigations applied. Mention possible transient request retries.

support-bot: Sent initial incident ping to cust-42 & cust-88; CS replied they saw degraded calls but app-level retries mitigated ~60% of failed requests.

david: Rolling full revert of config push across s1 cluster (using canary done). Running patch rollout: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/rate-limiter -n prod -l cluster=s1
kubectl apply -f runbooks/limiter-revert.yaml
```

maria: Good. Let's also enable fallback routing for low-tier customers to the lower-latency cache model to reduce load on limiter while we stabilize.

kevin: Fallback routing toggle set to true for tenant-group low-tier. Monitoring.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-78912 acknowledged by kevin at 2026-03-11T10:46:12Z.

maria: Handing off active response to kevin (next oncall). I'll update incident channel and start a postmortem doc once we have timeline. If anything regresses, wake me.

kevin: Taking over. Current state: 429s down 90%, token refill 500s reduced but still a few errors. Plan: finish revert rollout, monitor for 30m, then demote alert if stable.

sasha: Added runbook step: check autoscaler metrics and ensure controller-min is 2 for limiter cluster. Filed infra-task #INF-511 to add guardrail.

support-bot: CS updated customers with ETA ~30m for full recovery. Cust-101 asked for periodic updates.

maria: Action items recap: 1) kevin - complete revert and monitor (in progress). 2) david - investigate root cause of policy 404 during autoscaler events. 3) sasha - add autoscaler guardrail PR. 4) support - customer comms. We'll capture logs and metric snapshots for postmortem.

kevin: Revert rollout completed at 2026-03-11T10:56:30Z. No repeat spikes for last 6m. Lowering alert to P2 and silencing PD for noise.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert resolved by kevin at 2026-03-11T10:58:00Z. Incident closed; follow-up required: postmortem + runbook update.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll create the postmortem doc and link it here. Please attach any relevant logs and timelines.

support-bot: Closing support ticket #INC-2738 as incident update sent.

sasha: Quick note for postmortem: include exact autoscaler events + KV latencies from 10:30-11:00 UTC, and the config push diffs.

kevin: leaving final note: temporary hotfix (timeout increase) reverted after stable. Full fix tracked in INF-511.

maria: Handoff complete. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
